The "stealth" bear market is in full-swing.

While the Nasdaq 100 erased -$4 trillion in 25 days, the "S&P 500 Excluding AI" hit a RECORD high on Friday.

AI stocks fell over -13% in October while the S&P 500 Excluding AI gained+8%.

hits.draft_en:
The Nasdaq 100 lost $4 trillion in 25 days. The S&P 500 excluding AI closed Friday at a record high.

The money rotated instead of leaving. Midterms are Tuesday, and stocks have historically done well in the months after, whoever wins.

operator_posts.text: US summer gasoline consumption was the weakest in about 25 years outside 2020. The oil shock is already cooling demand, and the Fed has no reason to pile on.

Gulf allies are reportedly being told to prepare for US strikes on Iran as early as Nov 4, while Pakistan says it is cautiously optimistic on mediation. Pressure and talks in the same week is what leverage looks like.

Tehran keeps losing options. Washington keeps adding them.
